description: Browse and filter the audited Radial Switchboard phonebook by keyword substring and Virginia Scout health grade without consuming matchmaking call quota. Use when exploring catalog coverage by name, vendor, or grade; use matchmake_agent_crew instead when ranking capability-matched finalists for execution.

grade_filter.description: Filter by Virginia Scout audit grade ('AB' live <=350ms default, 'A' <=150ms, 'B' <=350ms, 'C' <=700ms, 'D' offline code, 'ALL' every non-poison record).

limit.description: Maximum number of directory records to return (1..50, default 20).

query.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter matched against agent_id, name, description, and endpoint URL.

name: search_agent_directory

agents.description: Matching directory records with grade, coupler, and endpoint metadata.

returned_count.description: Number of records included in agents.

total_matching.description: Total phonebook records matching the filter.

title: Search Live Audited Agent Directory
